thesis: China's leading down-jacket brand, net cash with ROIC of 68.7% and an 11.97% FCF yield, trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales, where the price implies a -12.8% revenue decline its stable margins and recovering cash flow do not show.
reason: Fundamentals are intact on the rolling view and the valuation remains at the floor of its own history and below peers; nothing has changed since the 2026-11-08 HOLD. Not an ADD: no trend support and interim results are two days out. The position stays at its existing size.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the five-year low of 57.2%, signalling loss of brand pricing power.
TTM net margin falls below 10%, reversing the five-year rise to 14.6% and indicating the brand premium has eroded.
TTM ROIC falls below 40%, a reversion toward FY2022 levels that undercuts the moat thesis.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 five-year low of 12.2%, signalling inventory or working-capital stress from a demand down-cycle.
